about_the_game:
WELCOME TO ATOM ASSAULT, RTS CHAOS STARTS NOW!

Atom Assault is a full 3D indie RTS where strategy and stupidity hold hands. Everything explodes, infantry fish for money, and you can literally pilot nukes. From the creators of Nuke Them All, this is classic RTS energy with a cheeky twist and graphics inspired by Totally Accurate Battle Simulator and Minecraft.

RED VS BLUE, NO MERCY

Lead the Red Desert Sharks against the Blue Empire of Metal Scull. The battlefield is a fully destructible playground. Blow up structures, torch the map, chain huge explosions, and keep the pressure on. Day flips to night, shadows slide across the terrain, and rain and thunder crash right into the fight.

PLAY IT YOUR WAY

Classic RTS controls feel instantly familiar. Groups, waypoints, rally points, clean production flow, and C&C style resource collection. Then the fun starts. Infantry fish for cash, hop between islands to grab oil rigs, and keep your eco booming. Build towers and walls for a tight defense or push hard with raw aggression. A mix of units and abilities lets you smash, burn, blast, and outplay in your own style.

CHAOS BUTTONS INCLUDED

Nuke Mode lets you take first person control of a nuclear missile and steer it right into the enemy base. Airstrike Mode drops you into the attack run so you guide destruction with your own hands. It is dumb, loud, and ridiculously fun.

RISE OF THE ZOMBIE BOSS

Brace for chaos, when night falls the ground cracks open and a swarm of zombies spills into the battlefield with a towering Zombie Boss leading the charge. It doesn’t care about red or blue, it just tears into anything that moves, forcing both sides to adapt fast, scramble defenses, and survive the unexpected third enemy that turns every match into pure unpredictable fun.

RTS WITH A SMILE

If you miss lighthearted RTS chaos with real strategy, destructible worlds, dynamic weather, and silly economy twists, Atom Assault delivers. Inspired by the energy of 8-Bit Armies, Command and Conquer, Red Alert, Company of Heroes, KKND, and the legendary Z.

CALL TO ARMS
Play the demo, wishlist Atom Assault, and jump into the discussions to share your wildest feature ideas with Papa Mike, the indie developer making all this chaos happen.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WIN10 or WIN11
  • Processor: equivalent to an Intel Core 2 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Atom Assault throws you into a chaotic Red vs Blue war where everything explodes, infantry fish for money, and you can even pilot nukes in first person. Full 3D, fully destructible world, fast, funny, proudly indie. If you miss old school RTS mayhem, this one hits hard.
